about_the_game:
Play as Prio and go through different levels and get to the end! Experience two dimensions as you jump through platforms or navigate through mazes. From the open-space 3D world to a classic-style 2D world, you'll face different levels throughout the game.

Play in 3D

Go through different levels with unique challenges and multiple ways of overcoming.

Experience the two worlds meet

Play in 2D as you encounter special levels that progress after beating the unique minigame.

Or just play classic, fully in 2D

Tone down the game and play in one dimension less.

Or play infinitely to your hearts desire

Pick your adventure, play longer and see how far you can go!

Complete levels and experience a different gameplay based on the mode you pick. Don't die though or else you'll be back at the start! Play a new set of levels that change with each playthrough. Get to the end to claim victory! Who knows what you'll find there...

  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Raspberry Pi 4
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.0 Capable Graphics Card

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Raspberry Pi 5 (OC)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan 1.2 Capable Graphics Card
